jobs.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.   Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.   What is the role? Roku s Content Distribution team drives strategic growth by sourcing, negotiating, and closing distribution partnerships with leading streaming video providers and major TV networks. As Director, Content Distribution, UK, you will lead strategy and execution for Roku s content distribution business in the UK. You will directly own high-value, complex negotiations with local public service broadcasters (PSBs), operators, and digital distributors, and guide the long-term roadmap for partner acquisition, renewals, and revenue expansion in the market. This role requires a senior leader with a proven track record of closing large, strategic content deals, deep expertise in streaming and subscription business models, and established C-level relationships across the UK media industry. You will shape how Roku is perceived by the local media community and represent Roku in the UK and EU.    How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You will own products from the first conversation about a problem to the moment customers use them, and keep improving them after launch. That means figuring out what matters, cutting the scope to something useful, designing the experience and API, building across the stack, and taking responsibility for how it works in production. You will own clearing products for Global Banks and Financial Institutions such as big Banks in Mexiko, fintechs in Nigeria or Central Banks in Southeast Asia. This could be anything across accounts, payments, treasury, credit, FX, multi-currency, our public APIs or the dashboard. jobs.title: Audit Specialist
jobs.description: Responsible for conducting independent audits of warehouse operations, inventory transactions, and documentation to ensure inventory accuracy, compliance with company policies and procedures, and effectiveness of internal controls. The role involves physical inventory verification, transaction testing, reconciliation of inventory records, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions to minimize discrepancies and operational risks. Key Responsibilities: Conduct regular physical inventory counts and verify actual stocks against Oracle/ERP system records. Audit receiving, storage, issuance, production returns, and dispatch transactions. Review and validate supporting documents, inventory records, and warehouse transactions. Investigate inventory discrepancies, including shortages, overages, unrecorded items, and recurring variances. Monitor the movement and accountability of raw materials, packaging materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and spare parts. Evaluate warehouse documentation, system records, authorization, and compliance with established procedures. Identify operational risks, control weaknesses, and potential inventory losses. Monitor corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Prepare clear and accurate audit reports with findings and recommendations. Coordinate with warehouse, production, and other departments regarding audit findings and follow-up activities.

You will work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts to define new analytics capabilities that give our customers the information they need to make decisions under pressure and accelerate their digital transformation. These are live programmes with real operational stakes, delivered into demanding, secure settings across the UK MOD, NATO, and allied European partners. jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the Role As Director, Fraud, you will lead Airwallex’s First Line of Defence (1LoD) Fraud function. You will own the design, execution, and continuous optimization of our global fraud strategy, policies, detection systems, and operational workflows across Airwallex’s financial infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for stopping fraud in real time while keeping friction low for legitimate, high-growth global businesses. Airwallex processes billions in cross-border payments, multi-currency corporate cards, merchant acquiring, and embedded finance products. You and your team will directly defend our ecosystem against card fraud, account takeover (ATO), merchant bust-out, payment scams, and synthetic identities. jobs.description: About The Team The Data Understanding team is responsible for creating the high quality datasets and their quantized representation for OpenAI. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Build scientifically sound evaluation pipelines across simulation and real robots, measuring success, precision, speed, robustness, and recovery. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Developer Experience (DevEx)
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder. AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works. The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will: Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers. jobs.title: Closer (m/f) - Investor Relations in Düsseldorf
jobs.description: Late shift. High stakes. Six US time zones. One shot per call. This is a genuine job posting - not a ghost job! Let's skip the part where we tell you this is “an exciting opportunity in a dynamic environment.” You've read that sentence four hundred times and seen it all. Here's what's actually true: We need an experienced, financially literate Closer who speaks English on a native or C2 Level, can pick up a phone at 3:30pm, talk to a stranger with eight figures in a brokerage account somewhere in Wyoming or Connecticut, get them to sign a convertible promissory note before their assistant walks in with coffee. That's it. That's the job. Everything else is detail. Who We Are Meridion AG runs the show from Monheim & Düsseldorf. Our US arm, Meridion Dynamics Inc., builds intelligent software and smart energy technology. But you're not selling the product. You're closing the investment that funds it. Different animal, different muscle. Aufgaben What You'll Actually Do Take warm(ish) leads from our setters - accredited US investors who already know we called - and close them on convertible promissory notes. Walk investors through the accreditation process without losing them to paperwork fatigue. Hold the line, know the terms cold, and answer the “wait, what happens if you don't hit your IPO timeline” question without blinking. If a setter is running low on appointments, out sick or on vacation, you step in and run up to 100 outbound cold calls that day to convert cold leads into your Closing appointments. Yes, a hundred. We count :) Talk to people who have people and AI to screen their calls - and get past their Gatekeepers. Qualifikation What You Bring Real closing experience - several years of it, in high-ticket sales, investment products, or anything else where “no” is the opening bid, not the final answer. This is not a rookie position. English at a genuine native level. Not “I watched a lot of Suits.” You need to sound like you belong in a room with a family office

jobs.title: Junior Consultant in der Medizin (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Die meisten Einstiegsjobs in der Unternehmensberatung bedeuten: Analysen vorbereiten. Präsentationen bauen. Dem Senior Consultant zuarbeiten. Dieser nicht. Bei uns hast Du bereits früh direkten Kontakt mit Praxisinhabern, die sich für eine Zusammenarbeit mit uns interessieren. Du besprichst mit Ihnen „wo der Schuh drückt“ und zeigst Lösungsansätze auf. Darauf, ein Unternehmen mit Mitarbeitern, Prozessen, Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung zu führen, bereitet sie ihr Studium dagegen kaum vor. Genau hier kommen wir ins Spiel. Wer wir sind Die MediKom Consulting GmbH ist eine auf ambulante Medizin spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung mit Sitz in Nürnberg. Wir haben hunderte Arztpraxen dabei begleitet, ihre Wirtschaftlichkeit zu verbessern und ihre Zukunft zu sichern. Wir sind zwölf feste und freie Mitarbeitende. Das heißt: Deine Arbeit ist sichtbar. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (m/w/d) mit Claude Code
jobs.description: Als Product Engineer verantwortest Du bei uns ein Produkt als Ganzes. Du sprichst mit Kunden und Team, findest heraus, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden muss, und entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was wegfällt. Dann setzt Du es mit Claude um, bringst es live und schaust, ob es im Alltag der Nutzer funktioniert. Was Du dort lernst, wird die nächste Version. Wer wir sind Lightweb Media ist eine AI-first Software- und KI-Entwicklungsfirma mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg. Bei uns läuft die gesamte Firma über Claude: Entwicklung, Betrieb, Projektmanagement und Kommunikation. Dafür haben wir eigene Werkzeuge gebaut: ein Company Brain, in dem unser Wissen und unsere Abläufe liegen, ein eigenes Secret Management und ein eigenes KI-Projektmanagement-Tool. Daneben entwickeln wir eigene Produkte und B2B-Plattformen für Kunden, die im Betrieb laufen müssen. Das machst Du Du setzt Projekte von der Idee bis zum Deployment um und betreust sie danach weiter: Anforderungen klären, Lösung entwerfen, bauen, ausliefern, beobachten, verbessern. Du orchestrierst Claude und Subagenten über mehrere Repositories parallel, mit Plan, Review-Schritten und Freigaben vor Push und Deploy. Ob etwas funktioniert, prüfst Du an der echten Datenbank und im laufenden Betrieb. Releases bringst Du selbst live, schaust danach auf Health-Checks, Logs und Fehlertracking und behebst, was auffällt. Du verantwortest Infrastruktur und Deployments: Server, Container, CI/CD, Monitoring und Sicherheitsupdates. Am Company Brain baust Du mit: Skills, Hooks, Routinen und die Regeln, nach denen unsere Agenten arbeiten. Was sich wiederholt, machst Du zu einer Routine, die von selbst läuft. Nach jedem Release schreibst Du die Nachricht an Kunden und kommunizierst im Team. Das erwarten wir außerdem Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung Mindestens sechs Monate Arbeit mit Claude Erfahrung mit Infrastruktur und Deployments: Linux-Server, Docker, CI/CD und Releases, die Du selbst live gebrach

jobs.description: About machineMD At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.  Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.  With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. jobs.description: Role Description As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions. Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox . Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here . Responsibilities Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams. Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns. Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments. Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows. Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas. Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. jobs.title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
jobs.description: About Genesis We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake. We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers. The role General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too. You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area. You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently. What you will do Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection

jobs.title: Senior HR Adviseur
jobs.description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen

jobs.title: Head of Finance and Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert. Aufgaben Du leitest Finance, IT, People und Operations: neun Menschen in vier Disziplinen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese vier Disziplinen zu führen, zu entwickeln und auf gemeinsame Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten auszurichten. Auch dort, wo du selbst nicht die Fachexpertin oder der Fachexperte bist. Gleichzeitig bist du Ansprechpartner für das C-Level (CEO, CGO und CRO) und die Teamleads in den anderen Abteilungen. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Ergebnisverantwortung liegt dabei eindeutig im Finanzbereich. Dort führst du ein Team von vier Personen in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (AR/AP) und verantwortest den Rechnungslegungszyklus von Anfang bis Ende: Buchhaltung, Zahlungsläufe, Mahnwesen und Payroll bis hin zum abgeschlossenen Monat und den Zahlen, die das Haus verlassen. Du überschaust die Systeme, die diese Zahlen erzeugen – DATEV, Billing-Plattformen, CRM und Data Warehouse und bist in der Lage diese nach modernen KI basierten Standards miteinander zu verzahnen um ein fortlaufendes Reporting aufzubauen. Es ist weder eine rein strategische noch eine rein operative Position. Für IT und Office führst du über Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten: Hardware, Onboarding, Compliance Standards wie ISO 27001 und 9001 sind dabei von dir zu koordinieren. Unser CFO wechselt begleitend in ein Fractional-Modell und bleibt bei Board-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsthemen eng dabei, du bekommst also einen erfahrenen Sparringspartner, ohne dass jemand über deinem Tagesgeschäft sitzt. Qualifikation Mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Finanzfunktion in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit eigener Verantwortung

Write code that line engineering can take over: structured, tested and documented. Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software. Interest in software that runs on hardware, outside the data centre. jobs.description: The Embedded Engineer brings N3XT’s hardware to life. You write firmware for sensor front-ends, payload controllers, power systems and communication modules, bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, and build the low-level interfaces the application software depends on. jobs.title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team! We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet. We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates. How we work: Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies. Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations. AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs. Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them. Your responsibilities: Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions. Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal. Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers. Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments. Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build. Improve our agent

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) - Werkstudium oder Pflichtpraktikum
jobs.description: Ein Abschluss ist bei uns kein Ziel, sondern ein Startpunkt. Ab da sorgst du dafür, dass aus einem Vertrag ein zufriedener Kunde wird. Bloom Future bringt Jugendliche zwischen 15 und 20 über Selbstreflexion zu passenden Ausbildungswegen und verbindet sie mit Ausbildungsbetrieben aus der Region. Die Unternehmen kaufen dabei keine Plattform, sie wollen passende Bewerbungen für ihre Ausbildungsplätze. Ob wir das liefern, entscheidet sich nicht im Verkaufsgespräch, sondern in den zwölf Monaten danach. Warum diese Rolle das Bindeglied ist Unser Vertrieb gewinnt die Unternehmen, unser Marketing sorgt dafür, dass ihre Stellen bei den richtigen Jugendlichen ankommen. Du sitzt genau dazwischen. Du kennst die Ziele unserer Kunden, siehst in den Zahlen, ob unsere Maßnahmen wirken, und sorgst dafür, dass Vertrieb, Marketing und Kunde immer auf demselben Stand sind. Aufgaben Was dich hier erwartet Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach dem Abschluss und begleitest sie durch das Onboarding. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen bringst du ihre Stellenanzeigen auf der Plattform so in Form, dass sie bei Jugendlichen wirklich ankommen. Danach wird es analytisch. Du wertest aus, wie die Kampagnen und Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden laufen: Wie oft werden die Stellen gesehen, wie viele Klicks und Bewerbungen kommen rein, wo hakt es? Liegt ein Kunde hinter seinen Zielen, erkennst du das früh und stimmst mit dem Marketing ab, welche Maßnahme jetzt greift, etwa eine regionale Anzeigenkampagne oder eine überarbeitete Stellenanzeige. Aus diesen Zahlen machst du Kommunikation. Du erstellst regelmäßige Reports für unsere Kunden, schreibst Newsletter und hältst den Kontakt so, dass Unternehmen jederzeit wissen, was mit ihren Stellen passiert und was wir als Nächstes tun. Dabei denkst du das Schuljahr mit. Jugendliche suchen nicht das ganze Jahr gleich, rund um Praktikumsphasen, Halbjahresinformation oder Zeugnisse verändert sich die Nachfrage. Diesen Rhythmus nutzt du, um die richtigen Maßnahmen zur richt

These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.   PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. jobs.description: Wer wir sind F& | FOCUS & FLOW ist ein Beratungs-Hub für Transformation und Prozessverbesserung. Daraus entwickeln wir Beratungsprodukte, Trainings und Workshops, vor Ort und virtuell. Unser Anspruch dabei ist, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Gemeinwohl zusammenzudenken. Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz. Wer bei uns mitarbeitet, sieht schnell, was die eigene Arbeit bewirkt. Aufgaben WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET: Im Mittelpunkt steht die LinkedIn-Präsenz unseres Geschäftsführers. Er ist das Gesicht von FOCUS & FLOW und für viele unserer Kund:innen der erste Berührungspunkt mit uns. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Präsenz mit ihm gemeinsam aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge in seiner Stimme. Dafür lernst du, wie er denkt, argumentiert und formuliert, und triffst seine Tonalität so, dass seine Beiträge nach ihm klingen und nicht nach Marketing. Du entwickelst mit ihm Themen und Formate, planst die Veröffentlichungen und hältst den Redaktionsplan am Laufen. Du baust sein Netzwerk strategisch aus: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen aus dem Mittelstand, bereitest Vernetzungen vor und behältst im Blick, wer auf seine Inhalte reagiert. Interessante Kontakte übergibst du strukturiert an unser Pre-Sales-Team und stimmst dich eng mit den Kolleg:innen ab. So wird aus Reichweite echtes Geschäft. jobs.title: Chargé.e missions qualité
jobs.description: Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ? Dans le cadre de la réorganisation du service Qualité, nous recherchons notre futur.e Chargé.e missions qualité. Ton Rôle : Sous la Responsabilité du Responsable qualité site, tu participes à la gestion de la qualité et à la libération des produits sur le site de MGA MedTech. C’est à dire ? Tu participes à la validation des procédés de fabrication dans le respect des normes en vigueur que ce soit dans le cadre de nouveaux projets ou suite à des modifications. Tu traites les anomalies, les non conformités, les dérogations, les avis de modification ou réclamations clients et décides, en concertation avec les contributeurs nécessaires, du devenir des produits concernés et des actions à mener. Tu suis les Actions Correctives et Préventives (CAPA) initiées suite aux écarts et réclamations clients. Tu effectues le contrôle d’entrée des pièces ou sous-ensemble en provenance de nos fournisseurs. Tu vérifies la complétude et l’exactitude de l’ensemble des enregistrements de production et de contrôle. Enfin, tu libères les produits selon les instructions Client et les processus en vigueur, fais remonter les écarts détectés. Proposer des améliorations si besoin. Tu participer à la gestion des ECME. ♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ? Issu.e d’une formation type BUT QLIO, tu disposes d’une première expérience similaire. Notre package : Rémunération annuelle sur 13 mois (27K-35K adaptable selon ton profil) Tickets restaurant de 9.50 euros (60%part employeur) Intéressement Plan Epargne salariale (Abondement de 25%) Base hebdomadaire sur 37.5 heures : 4.33 heures supplémentaires majorées à 25% + 6 jours de RTT/ an. 2 jours de repos d’assiduité Nos autres avantages : CSE : évènements + Club employés : plateforme d’avantages, de réductions et d’offres (billetterie parcs, spectacles, concerts, place de cinéma, voyages, shopping, loisirs sportifs, culture) MGAme: challenges et évènements interne Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale. We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. About the role We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue. This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement. jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features. You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact. This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Exploring & Analyzing Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions

jobs.description: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. jobs.description: RDQ327R180 Staff Security Engineer, Incident Response The Incident Response team s mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardised manner. We re a tight-knit team of security incident responders and incident handlers doing "Security for Databricks on Databricks", using our own platform to create near-real-time log analytics, alerting and forensics. You will be an individual contributor on the security Incident Response (IR) team at Databricks, reporting to the regional IR manager. You will be responsible for conducting security analysis and forensics, responding to high-priority alerts and contributing to automations and agentic capabilities. You will be a security multiplier and help the team scale security incident response at Databricks. The impact you will have: You will respond to incidents as part of a distributed 24x7 operations and on-call schedule. You will triage and respond to security events and alerts, ensuring quick and effective containment. You will conduct analysis and forensics across a range of data sources to determine the timeline and impact of security events. You will provide technical leadership and influence team direction. You will develop solutions, including leveraging AI and agentic platforms, to deliver autonomous capabilities, expedite your work and scale the impact of the team. You will communicate technical decisions through design docs and tech talks, and mentor junior security responders via security guidance, design reviews and code reviews. What we look for: Bachelor s Degree AND 7+ years experience in Incident Response work OR Master s Degree AND 5+ years experience. Cloud security expertise in at least 1 of AWS, GCP or Azure, and proficiency in the others. Proficiency in AI/LLM and agentic capabilities. jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions. We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar. As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform. The Care team's primary objective is to build "Phoenix," our new, comprehensive back-office system. Your role will be to contribute to the creation of this unified back-office and to ensure our customer relation agents can operate seamlessly. You will work within a multi-stack team of 3 Backend & 1 Frontend Engineer. You will collaborate closely with the Community Relations Team (CRT) as well as with Product Managers from other teams to best define needs and ensure seamless integration across the company. Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités… Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences. Prêt à conjuguer votre leadership, votre fibre commerciale et votre expertise dans un rôle à fort impact? Véritable entrepreneur au sein du Groupe, vous pilotez la création complète de l’agence : développement commercial, structuration opérationnelle, recrutement progressif et représentation locale. A la fois grand ordonnateur, gestionnaire et optimisateur, vous êtes porté par un fort esprit d’entreprendre , qui contribue activement à la bonne gestion de votre agence. De la phase commerciale au déploiement du projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, vous contribuez à la chaine de valeur et à l’image de marque du Groupe Fondasol. Vos principales missions Vous assurez le développement commercial , en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes (Géotechnique, Hydrogéologie, Environnement, Pathologie des Structures, etc.). Vous êtes le garant de la qualité de la relation client et de l'acquisition de nouveaux projets. Excellent gestionnaire, vous assurez la traduction de vos actions en performance économique

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. jobs.description: At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life. So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money. Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries . What we build Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers. Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys. Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data. Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded. Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business. The 5 values we work by Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent. Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure. Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem. Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate. No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble. jobs.description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth. This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers

Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) didirikan di Purwokerto, Jawa Tengah oleh Raden Bei Aria Wirjaatmadja tanggal 16 Desember 1895. Bank BRI memiliki layanan perbankan sampai seluruh penjuru Indonesia dan cukup terkenal oleh masyarakat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah BRILiaN Banking Associate Program (BBAP). Berpengalaman lebih dari 120 tahun, Bank BRI senantiasa memberikan kemudahan dan kecepatan dalam merespon berbagai kebutuhan nasabah. Dengan didukung oleh layanan perbankan yang prima, jutaan transaksi nasabah dikelola selama 24 jam sehari 7 hari seminggu melalui fasilitas layanan yang tersebar secara luas di seantero negeri. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
